content:
The Road Home

The road runs red beneath my feet,
Past farms where maize and millet meet.
The sun sinks low, the evening calls,
And shadows climb the village walls.
I hear the drums, I smell the rain,
I am a child of this soil again.
Though cities called with lights so bright,
Home is the lamp that burns tonight.
